---
name: policy-security
description: Security policy of the todo app team (version 1). Rules for input handling, destructive operations, rendering user text and dependencies. Load it whenever you write or review a spec, design or code that reads files or input, deletes or overwrites data, renders user text, or adds a dependency.
version: 1
owner: Khoa (tech lead, also security owner, simulated) · backup: Mai (simulated)
---

# Security policy · v1

Sample policy for the demo. Each rule has an ID; cite it as `policy-security@1#S<n>`.

- **S1.** Treat every imported file as untrusted. Validate it against the expected schema, reject unknown fields, cap its size at
  1 MB, never evaluate its content.
- **S2.** Any operation that overwrites or deletes more than one item asks for an explicit confirmation **before** it runs, and the
  confirmation says what will be lost (for example "Thay 12 việc hiện có bằng 30 việc trong file?").
- **S3.** Render user-provided text with `textContent`, never `innerHTML`.
- **S4.** No new external dependency (CDN script, library, web service) without sign-off from the security owner.

---
name: policy-ux
description: UX standard of the todo app team (version 2). Rules for feedback on failures, confirmations, screen states, wording and accessibility. Load it whenever you write or review a spec, design or UI code for the app.
version: 2
owner: Linh (UX owner, simulated) · backup: Thảo (product owner, simulated)
---

# UX standard · v2

Sample standard for the demo. Each rule has an ID; cite it as `policy-ux@2#U<n>`.

- **U1.** Never lose the user's data silently. Any failed save is shown on the same screen, in plain words, with what the user can do
  next.
- **U2.** No confirmation dialogs for actions on a single item: they happen at once and offer **Undo** for 10 seconds instead.
  Actions that overwrite or delete more than one item follow `policy-security#S2` (confirm first). *(Changed in v2, agreed by the UX
  and security owners, 2026-10-20.)*
- **U3.** Every list or screen defines its empty, loading and error states.
- **U4.** UI text is Vietnamese, short, and free of technical words (no "localStorage", "JSON", "console").
- **U5.** Every control works with the keyboard and has an accessible label.

# Plan: Nút "Xoá việc đã xong" (clear completed)

Status: draft · From: **no intent or spec yet** (see Gate) · Size: **Medium** · Date: 2026-10-29

## Context
The user wants one button that removes every finished task at once. Today the only way is clicking × on each done task
(`app/app.js:19` `remove`). This change deletes more than one item, so `policy-security@1#S2` and `policy-ux@2#U2` apply:
confirm **before** it runs, and the confirmation says what will be lost.

## Gate (read first)
Repo rule: a plan comes from an accepted spec, which comes from an accepted intent. None exists for this feature
(`intent/` has no match). Recommended path: `/write-intent` → person accepts → `/write-spec` → person accepts → this plan
becomes `plan/<YYYY-MM-DD>-xoa-viec-da-xong.md` (`Status: draft`) → person accepts → code. The questions below are what the
intent/spec must answer; the plan assumes the **Proposed** answers.

| Q | Question | Proposed | Who decides |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 | Exactly **one** done task: confirm (S2 only covers >1) or Undo 10 s (U2)? The app has no Undo today | Confirm for any count ≥ 1 — one rule, no Undo machinery. Needs Linh (UX) to agree it's not a U2 breach, else Undo is a separate change | Linh |
| Q2 | When the saved list is unreadable (`store.readError`), what does the button do? `save()` returns `'skipped'`, so the list would shrink on screen but nothing is written | Button disabled/hidden while `readError` | Khoa / Linh |
| Q3 | Button when there are 0 done tasks | Hidden | Linh |
| Q4 | Acts on the whole list or only the current filter? | Whole list (all done tasks), regardless of filter | Thảo |
| Q5 | Wording (U4): button, question, result | Button `Xoá việc đã xong`; question `Xoá {n} việc đã xong? Không lấy lại được, trừ khi bạn đã sao lưu ra file.`; result `Đã xoá {n} việc đã xong.` | Linh |
| Q6 | Dialog's yes-button is hard-coded `Thay` (`app/index.html:37`) | Make its label settable per question: `ask(question, yesLabel)`; import keeps `Thay`, this uses `Xoá` | Khoa |

## Files that change
- `app/backup.js` — DOM-free logic (reuse `fill`, `formatCount`, `persist`, `MESSAGES`):
  - `MESSAGES.confirmClearDone`, `MESSAGES.clearedDone`.
  - `clearDone({ store, todos, ask })` → `{ todos, message }`: counts `t.done`; 0 → returns `todos` unchanged; asks
    `fill(confirmClearDone, {n})`; "Huỷ"/Esc → unchanged, message `null`; yes → `rest = todos.filter(t => !t.done)`,
    `persist(store, rest)`; message is `MESSAGES.notSaved` on `'failed'`, else `clearedDone`. Export it.
- `app/index.html` — `<button type="button" id="clear-done" hidden>Xoá việc đã xong</button>` next to `#count`; yes-button
  gets an id (`#confirm-yes`) so its text can be set. Script order unchanged.
- `app/app.js` — `ask(question, yesLabel = 'Thay')` sets `#confirm-yes` text; `#clear-done` onclick awaits `clearDone`,
  assigns `todos`, `show(message)`, `render()`; `render()` sets `#clear-done.hidden` when no done tasks or `store.readError`.
- `app/style.css` — only if the button needs spacing.
- `tests/backup.test.js`, `tests/app.test.js`, `tests/static.test.js` — see Proof.

`app/store.js` does **not** change (still the only file touching `localStorage`).

## Order of work
1. `backup.js`: messages + `clearDone`, with its unit tests.
2. `index.html` + `app.js`: button, `ask` label, render visibility; app tests.
3. Static test for the new markup; full `node --test`; manual check in browser.

## Risks
- Deleting user data: the confirm must appear before any change to `todos` (S2). Test asserts list unchanged after "Huỷ".
- Read-error path: clearing must never call `store.replace`; with the button hidden on `readError` it is unreachable, and
  `clearDone` still goes through `save()` (which skips) as a second guard.
- Shared dialog: changing the yes label must not break import (`tests/app.test.js:120`, import asks with `Thay`).
- Filter = `done` after clearing shows an empty list; `#empty` is based on the whole list, so it shows only if no tasks remain (U3).
- Save failure (storage full) shows `notSaved` (U1); list on screen already shrunk — same behaviour as `remove`.

## Proof
| Step | Test |
|---|---|
| 1 | `backup.test.js`: question text for n=1, 3, 1.000 (dot formatting); "Huỷ" returns same array, no save; yes removes only done, keeps order, calls `save` once; `'failed'` → `notSaved`; 0 done → no ask |

Repo rule: a plan comes from an accepted spec, which comes from an accepted intent. None exists for this feature

becomes `plan/<YYYY-MM-DD>-xoa-viec-da-xong.md` (`Status: draft`) → person accepts → code. The questions below are what the
intent/spec must answer; the plan assumes the **Proposed** answers.

| Q | Question | Proposed | Who decides |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 | Exactly **one** done task: confirm (S2 only covers >1) or Undo 10 s (U2)? The app has no Undo today | Confirm for any count ≥ 1 — one rule, no Undo machinery. Needs Linh (UX) to agree it's not a U2 breach, else Undo is a separate change | Linh |
| Q2 | When the saved list is unreadable (`store.readError`), what does the button do? `save()` returns `'skipped'`, so the list would shrink on screen but nothing is written | Button disabled/hidden while `readError` | Khoa / Linh |
| Q3 | Button when there are 0 done tasks | Hidden | Linh |
| Q4 | Acts on the whole list or only the current filter? | Whole list (all done tasks), regardless of filter | Thảo |
| Q5 | Wording (U4): button, question, result | Button `Xoá việc đã xong`; question `Xoá {n} việc đã xong? Không lấy lại được, trừ khi bạn đã sao lưu ra file.`; result `Đã xoá {n} việc đã xong.` | Linh |

    `persist(store, rest)`; message is `MESSAGES.notSaved` on `'failed'`, else `clearedDone`. Export it.

  gets an id (`#confirm-yes`) so its text can be set. Script order unchanged.
- `app/app.js` — `ask(question, yesLabel = 'Thay')` sets `#confirm-yes` text; `#clear-done` onclick awaits `clearDone`,
  assigns `todos`, `show(message)`, `render()`; `render()` sets `#clear-done.hidden` when no done tasks or `store.readError`.
- `app/style.css` — only if the button needs spacing.
- `tests/backup.test.js`, `tests/app.test.js`, `tests/static.test.js` — see Proof.

1. `backup.js`: messages + `clearDone`, with its unit tests.
2. `index.html` + `app.js`: button, `ask` label, render visibility; app tests.

- Deleting user data: the confirm must appear before any change to `todos` (S2). Test asserts list unchanged after "Huỷ".

- Shared dialog: changing the yes label must not break import (`tests/app.test.js:120`, import asks with `Thay`).
- Filter = `done` after clearing shows an empty list; `#empty` is based on the whole list, so it shows only if no tasks remain (U3).
- Save failure (storage full) shows `notSaved` (U1); list on screen already shrunk — same behaviour as `remove`.

| 1 | `backup.test.js`: question text for n=1, 3, 1.000 (dot formatting); "Huỷ" returns same array, no save; yes removes only done, keeps order, calls `save` once; `'failed'` → `notSaved`; 0 done → no ask |

| 3 | `static.test.js`: `#clear-done` exists, `type="button"`, has Vietnamese text (U5 label); `node --test` all green |
| Manual | `python3 -m http.server -d app 8000`: add 3, tick 2, click, Huỷ (nothing gone), click, Xoá (1 left, message shown); keyboard only (Tab/Enter/Esc) |

I've written the plan, but under this repo's rules it can't go to build yet. A plan has to come from an accepted spec, and there's no intent or spec for "clear completed". The steps are `/write-intent`, a person accepts it, `/write-spec`, a person accepts that, and then this plan goes in as `plan/<date>-xoa-viec-da-xong.md` with `Status: draft`. The plan lists what the intent and spec need to decide.

**Size: Medium** (`app/backup.js`, `app/app.js`, `app/index.html`, and tests). `store.js` doesn't change.

**Approach:**
- **Logic (`backup.js`):** a new `clearDone({ store, todos, ask })` that has no page code, like `importBackup`. It counts the done tasks, asks with `Xoá {n} việc đã xong? …`, and does nothing on "Huỷ". On yes it filters out the done tasks and saves through the existing `persist()`. If the save fails it shows the existing `notSaved` message.
- **Page (`index.html` / `app.js`):** a `#clear-done` button next to the count. It's hidden when there are no done tasks or when the saved list can't be read.
- **Confirmation dialog:** its yes button is hard-coded as `Thay` (`app/index.html:37`). `ask()` will take a label, so import keeps `Thay` and this feature uses `Xoá`.

**Policy:** deleting several tasks falls under `policy-security@1#S2` and `policy-ux@2#U2`, so it must confirm first and say what will be lost.

**Questions a person needs to answer** (each has a proposed answer in the plan):
1. **Only one done task:** S2 only requires a confirmation for more than one task. U2 says a single item should be deleted at once with a 10-second Undo, and the app has no Undo. I propose always confirming; Linh (UX owner) needs to agree.
2. **Saved list unreadable:** saving is skipped then, so tasks would disappear from the screen but nothing would be saved. I propose hiding the button.
3. **Whole list or current filter:** I propose clearing done tasks from the whole list.
4. **Wording:** Linh needs to approve the Vietnamese button, question and result text.

**Proof:** unit tests for the logic, tests for the page, a check of the HTML, then `node --test` and a manual run with mouse and keyboard.

The plan file is at `<home>/.claude/plans/add-a-clear-completed-linked-stardust.md`. Nothing in the repo was changed.
